appearance_facts.fact: The chart title is 'Number of Customers at Mall A in Town X'.

The horizontal axis is labeled 'Month' and includes labeled bars for 'January', 'February', and 'March'.
A dashed horizontal line labeled 'Average' is drawn at the 225 level on the vertical axis.
The bar for January reaches a height corresponding to 225 on the vertical axis, exactly at the level of the 'Average' line.
The bar for February reaches a height corresponding to 190 on the vertical axis, below the 'Average' line.
The bar for March reaches a height corresponding to 530 on the vertical axis, above the 'Average' line.
